'''Cheldu''' was an insectoid herbivore species native to [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]]. Though their appearance could be off-putting to some prospective owners, few mounts could match the loyalty and affectionate nature of the Cheldu.<ref name="Cartel Market">[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]]</ref>
